name: Columbia State Community College
tuition_note: In-state (resident) 2026-27 tuition & fees from columbiastate.edu/business-office/tuition-fees.html: $197/semester hour x 12 hrs = $2,364/sem tuition, plus mandatory fees $193/sem (Program Services $20, Technology $135, Student Activity $3, SGA $3, International Ed $10, Facilities $22). Annual full-time tuition & fees = ($2,364 + $193) x 2 = $5,114. Housing: null - Columbia State is a commuter community college with no on-campus housing listed.
